title: Pretty pleased but some flaws are very evident
text:
Pretty pleased but some flaws are very evident. So I'd really love to give this a 5-star review but after finding several flaws I cannot give it a five star first flaw I noticed was upon opening the item it was packed amazing but unfortunately upon pulling everything out to check the item I found that the drawers that sit on top of the desktop had detached from the long strip that they were once slightly nailed and glued to although it was an easy fix because I added more glue and was able to push them down upon their nails it was still a disappointment my next flaw that I found was regarding. Same area the mirror is supposed to attach to the back of the small drawers that sit on the table top however. Area with the small drawers does not attach to the tabletop itself it just is placed resting on top of the vanity table top I did not feel it was secure enough to attach the large heavy mirror so I opted to not attach it and to use my own vanity mirror that has lighting's you will see this in the pictures. I attached with this review overall I think it is a very cute unit with some slight flaws the bench seat. Comes with this vanity is very cute however you will also see that in my pictures I do not use it I set it aside and set my makeup unit on top of it for two reasons one I had a better seat to sit on and two the table top is a little small and I wanted the extra room and the seat came in perfect setting it to the side and using it for a little side table overall I should say I am pleased with it I think it came out very cute and I will enjoy I'm sure having this vanity while I get myself dressed I know my family is pleased that I'm out of the bathroom freeing up the bathroom space while I'm getting my makeup on
Id like to add this unit is very easy to put together other then adding the legs its pretty much completly assembled my 12 year old and i had it together in probably like 30 mins

product_metadata.title: Fineboard Antique Vanity Table in Wood Dressing Table Set with Stool 2 + 2 Organization Drawer and 1 Mirror, Brown
features: Antique Look Vanity: if you are looking for a vanity set with an antique look this is the perfect one for you. The two drawer vanity is designed to imitate antique design. The elegant vanity will fit right in with your antique furniture. It has one large mirror.

Contemporary Practical Design: Though fashioned lot look like an antique design, the table has contemporary lines and style and is designed to save space so it can fit into any modern compact home. The size is just right to store all your toiletries without hogging floor space.

Wood and Board Construction: The affordable vanity is made with pine wood and MDF board creating a product that is long lasting as well as cost effective to be affordable by all. It is embellished with carved floral motifs which add to its appeal.

Removable Mirror: The mirror assemble is not built into the dressing table. It can be removed and hung up on the wall giving you two small drawers and a long thin shelf to store the toiletries. The table can be used as a study table, office table, work desk or a console table.
Overall size: W26.8" x D15.7" x H51.2"/ W68cm x D40cm x H130cm, Table size: W26.8" x D15.7" x H29.5"/ W26.8" x D15.7" x H29.5", Stool size: W10.6" x D11" x H17"/ W27cm x D28cm x H44cm.
description: The vanity set is designed for elegance and beauty. It is a beautifully crafted piece of furniture that will be a proud addition to any bedroom. The clean lines and stylized mirror frame with fret work give it an antique style look. The contemporary lines and satin smooth glossy finish add to the overall appeal of this dressing table and mirror set with stool. The vanity set has a total of four drawers. Two larger ones built into the table and two attached to the removable mirror frame. All the four drawers are embellished with beautifully carved floral motifs. The drawers are pulling out type. The mirror frame is a stylized oval with scrolled fret work on the sides that add to its appeal. The mirror assembly is removable and can be hung up on the wall to increase the table top surface area. The table can be used by itself as a study table, work table, desk etc. The curved legs complete the styling of the dressing table. The set includes a matching stool that goes with the dressing table. The stool has the same curved legs and floral motif on the side to match the table. It is padded for comfort and upholstered in a matching fabric. Shipping size is 29.9" x12.6" x 24". The total weight is 39.7lbs. The diy package contains all that you will need to assemble the set.
